access_loopback_detail: Opens only on the hub machine (127.0.0.1). In Docker, that means only from inside the container.
access_loopback_risk: Safest. No other computer can open it; use an SSH tunnel.
access_lan_detail: This machine, plus private addresses on the hub's subnet and security.trusted_cidrs.
access_lan_risk: The default. Devices on the same local network can see the sign-in page; the password keeps them out.
access_cidrs_detail: This machine, plus the ranges listed in admin.cidrs (a VPN's range, for example).
access_cidrs_risk: Only the ranges you list. Public ranges still need TLS.
access_any_detail: The local network still works, and anyone can open it through the TLS port.
access_any_risk: Anyone on the internet can see the sign-in page. Only the password and rate limits keep them out.
